project_type: Monorepo: Python FastAPI backend + Cloudflare Worker edge + React/Vite frontend + Azure Bicep IaC
build_system: pnpm workspace (Node), pip-compile (Python), Docker, Azure Bicep
build_command: pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit
test_command: N/A for audit - this task produces a report file only
verification_instructions: Verify the audit report markdown file exists and is well-structured
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no package installs available. Report generation only.
contribution_requirements: Commit report as markdown to repo root
key_patterns: 9-pillar architecture, dual-LLM streaming, circuit breaker pattern, edge-first with JWT + rate limiting
directory_structure: Monorepo: apps/backend (FastAPI), apps/edge (CF Worker), apps/frontend (React+Vite), infra/azure (Bicep IaC), .github/workflows (CI/CD), scripts/ (verification), docs/ (architecture docs), frontend/src (legacy/additional)
